sql.sql:
select 'seg' k, segment_cd v, count(*) n from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'status', client_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'fstatus', facility_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
union all select 'role', banker_role, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'channel', channel, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_contact', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_fac', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
order by 1,2

select
 (select count(*)-count(distinct cif_no) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT) dup_cif,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' and (payoff_dt is not null or chgoff_dt is not null)) active_w_close,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' and maturity_dt < '2026-09-30') active_matured,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where commit_amt is null or commit_amt<=0) bad_commit,
 (select max(contact_dt) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT) max_ct,
 (select min(contact_dt) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT) min_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where contact_dt > '2026-09-30') future_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where contact_dt is null) null_ct,
 (select count(*)-count(distinct facility_id) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY) dup_fac,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT c where not exists (select 1 from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT k where k.cif_no=c.cif_no)) orphan_ct

with fac as (
  select cif_no, sum(commit_amt) active_commit, count(*) n_fac
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by cif_no),
ct as (
  select cif_no, max(contact_dt) last_any,
   max(iff(banker_role='RM',contact_dt,null)) last_rm,
   max(iff(banker_role='TM_OFFICER',contact_dt,null)) last_tm,
   count_if(contact_dt between '2026-06-25' and '2026-07-09') near_boundary
  from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by cif_no)
select c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.rm_id, r.rm_nm, r.team, f.active_commit, f.n_fac,
  ct.last_any, ct.last_rm, ct.last_tm, datediff(day, ct.last_any, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join ct on ct.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r on r.rm_id=c.rm_id
where c.segment_cd='LC' and f.active_commit>25000000
  and (ct.last_any is null or ct.last_any < dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date))
order by f.active_commit desc

with fac as (
  select f.cif_no, sum(f.commit_amt) active_commit,
    sum(iff(f.maturity_dt >= '2026-09-30', f.commit_amt, 0)) unmatured_commit,
    sum(iff(b.facility_id is not null, f.commit_amt, 0)) commit_with_sep_bal
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
  left join (select distinct facility_id from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY where as_of_dt='2026-09-30') b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id
  where f.facility_status='ACTIVE' group by f.cif_no)
select count(*) lc_gt25, count_if(active_commit=25000000) exactly25,
  count_if(unmatured_commit>25000000) gt25_unmatured, count_if(commit_with_sep_bal>25000000) gt25_with_sep_bal
from fac join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c on c.cif_no=fac.cif_no
where c.segment_cd='LC' and active_commit>=25000000
